hypotheses.direction: Long gap-up accepted sessions; short gap-down accepted sessions.

hypotheses.invalidation: Price closes back through prior close before entry or opening range midpoint fails acceptance.

hypotheses.primary_outcome: Direction-normalized underlying return from legal entry close to +30 completed minutes, clipped at session end.
hypotheses.required_data: Underlying one-minute OHLC candles for NIFTY, BANKNIFTY, SENSEX; prior-session close; completed first 15 one-minute bars.
setup_state_machine: LOAD prior complete session close
WAIT for first 15 completed bars
MEASURE gap from prior close to session open
ACCEPT if 09:30 close remains beyond 50% of gap in gap direction and above/below opening range midpoint
EMIT once at first legal bar after acceptance
hypotheses.single_emission_rule: At most one candidate per symbol-session.
hypotheses.structural_premise: A directional overnight gap that is accepted after the opening range reflects inventory repricing rather than immediate mean reversion.

hypotheses.direction: Short failed gap-up; long failed gap-down.

hypotheses.invalidation: Gap resumes beyond opening extreme before entry.

hypotheses.legal_entry_timestamp: Next completed one-minute timestamp after rejection close.
hypotheses.material_distinction_from_prior_work: Candidate identity depends on prior-close gap failure, not stretch-from-VWAP or ORB retest.
hypotheses.negative_expectation_falsifier: Reversal returns fail WFA/control separation or are concentrated in few sessions.
hypotheses.participants_or_behavior: Opening gap chasers unwind; liquidity providers fade failed displacement; hedgers reduce directional exposure.
hypotheses.persistence_rationale: Failed gap acceptance creates predictable inventory pain when price crosses back through prior close/opening midpoint.
hypotheses.primary_outcome: Direction-normalized underlying return from legal entry close to +45 completed minutes.

WAIT for gap open and first 30 completed bars
REJECT if price closes back inside 25% of prior-close gap or crosses prior close
EMIT reversal at first completed rejection close
hypotheses.single_emission_rule: At most one candidate per symbol-session.
hypotheses.structural_premise: A gap that cannot hold through the first 30 minutes indicates trapped directional open inventory and mean reversion pressure.

hypotheses.direction: Long after sweep below prior low and reclaim; short after sweep above prior high and reclaim.
hypotheses.entry_event: First completed reclaim close after sweep.
hypotheses.invalidation: Second close beyond swept extreme before entry.
hypotheses.known_prior_research: Distinct from ORB and VWAP; uses previous session extrema as liquidity pools.
hypotheses.legal_entry_timestamp: Next completed one-minute timestamp after reclaim.
hypotheses.material_distinction_from_prior_work: Candidate is anchored on prior-day high/low stop-run failure rather than opening range or VWAP state.
hypotheses.negative_expectation_falsifier: Reclaim does not outperform matched random entries around prior-day levels.
hypotheses.participants_or_behavior: Stop orders and breakout liquidity are absorbed; trapped breakout traders unwind; stronger hands reclaim value.
hypotheses.persistence_rationale: Prior-day extremes are visible liquidity pools; failed auction beyond them can create short-horizon directional flow.
hypotheses.primary_outcome: Direction-normalized underlying return from entry to +30 completed minutes.
hypotheses.required_data: Underlying one-minute OHLC candles for current and prior complete session.
setup_state_machine: LOAD prior-day high and low
WAIT for current session sweep beyond level by minimum bps
REQUIRE completed close back inside prior range
EMIT away from swept level on next bar
hypotheses.single_emission_rule: At most one high sweep and one low sweep per symbol-session; first side only if both occur.
hypotheses.structural_premise: A sweep beyond prior-day high/low followed by reclaim marks failed stop-run liquidity and continuation away from the swept level.
